timeline.summary: Trent reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹5,028 Cr and recommended a 1:2 bonus issue alongside a ₹6 per share dividend.
Trent reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹5,028 Cr and announced a ₹2,500 Cr fundraise proposal.
Trent recommended a 1:2 bonus issue, a ₹6 per share dividend, adopted ESOP 2026, and approved an enabling ₹2,500 Cr fundraise alongside FY26 financial results.
CARE Ratings reaffirmed Trent Limited's credit ratings and enhanced its commercial paper limit to ₹500 Cr.
Trent shareholders approved capital re-classification, bonus issue, and ESOP 2026 via postal ballot.
Trent dispatched notices for its Integrated Annual Report 2025-26 to unregistered members and reminded physical shareholders to complete KYC compliance.
Trent allotted 17.77 Cr bonus equity shares in a 1:2 ratio on June 5, 2026, increasing its paid-up capital to ₹53.32 Cr.
Trent announced the proposed divestment of its wholly owned subsidiary Netria Property Holdings to TreBits Investment Trust for ₹11.25 per share plus loan repayment of ₹171.91 crore.
